subject: Mental Models
title: Constraint as Creativity
description: Learn Constraint as Creativity in one minute.

hook.text: Dr. Seuss wrote Green Eggs and Ham using only 50 words after a bet with his publisher. Constraint forced brilliance.

buildup.text: Constraints narrow the solution space. A narrower space forces you to think harder and find more creative paths.

discovery.text: Twitter's 140-character limit spawned an entire new style of communication.

twist.text: Unlimited freedom often causes paralysis. Too many options overwhelm the brain.

climax.text: When stuck, add a constraint. Cut the budget, halve the time, or limit the tools. Creativity thrives inside tight boxes.

punchline.text: Tight boxes force creative escapes. Add constraints on purpose.

quiz.question: How do constraints boost creativity?
options: They narrow the solution space and force more inventive thinking
